title: VTC Badges — List — payload
description: List the badges the caller may see — every listed active badge and the ones they hold, own or are offered; every badge for an administrator — with how many of each they hold and where they stand with it. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

mine.description: Only badges the caller holds — at least one accepted award.

includeUnlisted.description: Administrators only (`vtc.badges.admin`): also the badges that are not `listed`. A member sees the unlisted badges they hold, own or are offered without it.

includeRetired.description: Administrators only (`vtc.badges.admin`): also the retired badges. A holder's retired badges are in vtc/badges/mine/list.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`, bound to the caller and the filters; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 200; the responder chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

MyState.title: MyState
MyState.description: Where the caller stands with a badge. `holder`: at least one accepted award. `offered`: an open offer names them. `requested`: an undecided request to join its badge group. `none`: nothing.

Response.title: VTC Badges — List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/badges/list/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/badges/list/0.1#response.

myCount.description: Accepted awards of this badge the caller holds; 0 where none.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.
